loadFailure.body: Check that the local service is running, then try again.

apiError.generic: The request could not be completed.
apiError.network: The browser could not reach Calendar Ghost.
apiError.unreadableResponse: The service returned an unreadable response.
apiError.account_access_check_failed: Calendar Ghost could not check this account's calendars. Try again shortly.
apiError.account_access_check_failed_authenticati: Google no longer accepts this account. Reauthorize it to restart the rules that use it.
apiError.account_access_check_failed_authorizatio: Google denied this account's calendar access. Reauthorize it, and confirm the Calendar API is enabled for your Google Cloud project.
apiError.account_disconnected: This account is disconnected. Reauthorize it in Settings first.
apiError.account_management_unavailable: Managing accounts needs the installation master key to be configured.
apiError.account_must_be_disconnected: Disconnect this account before you delete it permanently.
apiError.account_not_found: This account is no longer connected. Reload to see the current accounts.
apiError.account_required: Connect both accounts before you create a rule between their calendars.
apiError.activity_entry_not_found: This Activity entry no longer exists. It may have been cleared.
apiError.activity_rule_removed: This entry's rule was removed, so its events cannot be looked up.
apiError.administrator_required: Only an administrator of this Calendar Ghost can do that.
apiError.authorization_failed: Google did not authorize the account. Try connecting it again.
apiError.authorization_not_configured: This calendar provider is not configured on this installation.
apiError.bad_request: The request could not be completed.
apiError.conflict: That change conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
apiError.credentials_required: Sign in again, or use a valid Integration Token.
apiError.dependency_failed: A calendar provider did not respond as expected. Try again shortly.
apiError.duplicate_relationship: A rule from this calendar to that calendar already exists.
apiError.email_taken: Someone else already signs in with this email.
apiError.event_inspection_unavailable: Looking up events needs a configured calendar provider and the installation master key.
apiError.file_logging_off: File logging is off, so there are no log files to download or delete.
apiError.gone: That item is no longer available.
apiError.incorrect_credentials: That email and password do not match.
apiError.insufficient_scope: This Integration Token is not allowed to read Installation Status.
apiError.integration_token_not_found: This Integration Token no longer exists. Reload to see the current tokens.
apiError.invalid_activity_age: Choose one of the offered ages for clearing Activity.
apiError.invalid_authorization_state: This sign-in link expired or was already used. Start again from Settings.
apiError.invalid_email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
apiError.invalid_integration_token_name: Give the token a name of 1 to 80 characters, without line breaks or other control characters.
apiError.invalid_request: Some of the information is not valid. Check it and try again.
apiError.invalid_rule: This rule is not valid. Check its calendars and settings.
apiError.invalid_state_transition: This rule cannot change to that state right now. Reload and try again.
apiError.last_administrator: Someone else must be an administrator first. Calendar Ghost always keeps one who can sign in.
apiError.link_unusable: This link was already used, replaced, or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
apiError.mcp_not_running: The MCP server is starting or stopping. Try again in a moment.
apiError.method_not_allowed: This page is out of date. Reload it and try again.
apiError.not_a_calendar_change: The calendars are unchanged. To change what the rule does, edit its settings instead.
apiError.not_found: That item no longer exists. Reload to see the current state.
apiError.oauth_result_missing: Google did not return a sign-in result. Try connecting the account again.
apiError.only_me_needs_one_user: Only Me works only while you are the only person here. Delete the other people first.
apiError.password_policy: Choose a password of at least 12 characters.
apiError.provider_failed: {Provider} reported a problem. Try again shortly.
apiError.provider_not_configured: No calendar provider is configured on this installation.
apiError.registration_closed: Nobody can join while this Calendar Ghost is set to Only Me. Choose Invitation Only first.
apiError.removal_interrupted: Removal stopped after {processed} of {total} projections because {provider} reported a problem. Retry to continue.
apiError.removal_requires_authorization: Reauthorize the destination account before deleting projections, or keep them as detached events.
apiError.removal_requires_provider: Deleting projections needs a configured calendar provider and the installation master key.
apiError.replacement_interrupted: The new draft rule was created, but removing the previous rule stopped after {processed} of {total} projections. Open the previous rule to retry its removal.
apiError.request_failed: The request could not be completed.
apiError.rule_execution_unavailable: Running rules needs a configured calendar provider and the installation master key.
apiError.rule_not_executable: This rule cannot run in its current state. Reload to see what it is doing.
apiError.service_unavailable: This part of Calendar Ghost is not configured yet.
apiError.session_required: Your session ended. Sign in again.
apiError.setup_complete: Calendar Ghost is already set up. Sign in instead.
apiError.sign_in_throttled: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
apiError.source_change_not_found: This entry recorded no source change.
apiError.source_event_not_found: This entry has no source event to show.
apiError.storage_busy: Old Activity was cleared, but its space could not be reclaimed while a rule is synchronizing. Try again when it finishes.
apiError.user_deletion_interrupted: Deleting stopped before every rule was removed, because the calendar provider did not answer. Nothing else was deleted. Try again.
apiError.user_disabled: An administrator has turned off your access to this Calendar Ghost.
apiError.user_not_found: This person no longer has access to this Calendar Ghost.
apiError.your_own_state: You cannot turn off your own access.
